description:
Hiii,

I am Halima Riffi, an exchange student in Finland for this Fall. I am a computer science student with a specialization in AI. I am interested in this challenge because it would be a great idea to challenge my capabilities. Am I ready ?Nop, Am I supposed to be ready? Nop, but it is all about taking the risk to learn and be the best version of all times.  if you feel you are not ready or not qualified, you are  more than welcome to proof that you can do it .
